text: Grapes. G. R. A. P. E. S. Grapes.
instructions: Speak English warmly, clearly and naturally, as a friendly adult talking to a child. Use a normal conversational pace with crisp pronunciation and connected phrasing. Do not stretch vowels, separate syllables, whisper, sing, or add exaggerated dramatic pauses. A single word should be pronounced cleanly once. Say only the supplied text.
